license.notes: Zoo 1.17.0. The convenience store's hot dog roller grill, from the proposal's 'Roller dogs' (docs/proposals/GAS_STATION_SHOP.md: 'a slanted bank of chrome rollers turning under a clear hood, sausages in three or four distinct colours and thicknesses ... small labelled flag signs ... grease darkening the rollers toward the back, and a printed Buns panel across the front of the cabinet below') and the walker's photographs of 2026-09-28: two store stations (zones of one kind split by dividers, a black tube tag naming each) and a countertop merchandiser (rollers across the width, dogs in the grooves between them, a black control panel with dials, lights and a switch, a glass case with a bun shelf). A counter-height bun cabinet with a printed NICE BUNS panel; a steel pan and printed control panel with two knobs; rollers across the width climbing gently toward the back, each greasier than the one in front; columns of one kind each (pale, tan, deep red, a thin rolled one) with dogs in the grooves, chrome dividers and a black tag naming the kind; a glass hood on four posts, open at the lower front, with a shelf of buns when tall enough. Four submissions whatever the width: chrome, painted (colours and grease in the Wear vertex colour), glass, and one painted image. Nothing glows. Invented names only. Collision is the slot's box.
